column1: #  - module (also port module) is a package;

#  - a top-level value or function is a function, once: its type annotation is not a definition of its own, and a constant (limit = 10) is a function too, since Elm treats a zero-argument function and a value as one thing; names bound by let are local and are not definitions;
#  - type is a class (variants are not definitions), type alias is a type_alias;
#  - record fields, union variants, imports and calls are not definitions.
